shortcut.title: Scorciatoie di Chatelle
shortcut.description: Configura le scorciatoie per attivare la trascrizione vocale

transcribe.name: Scorciatoia Trascrizione
transcribe.description: La scorciatoia da tastiera per registrare e trascrivere la tua voce.

cancel.name: Scorciatoia Annulla
cancel.description: La scorciatoia da tastiera per annullare la registrazione in corso.

draft_reply.name: Bozza di risposta
draft_reply.description: Legge la chat sullo schermo e digita una risposta nel campo attivo.

draft_reply_hint.name: Guide the AI Reply
draft_reply_hint.description: Hold and say what you want to reply. Let go, and Chatelle writes it.

watch_chat.name: Message Alerts
watch_chat.description: Watches the open chat and tells your Telegram when a new message comes in.

microphone.title: Microfono
microphone.phoneFirewall: The first time, Windows may ask to allow Chatelle on private networks. Allow it.

phoneSteps.title: Use your phone as the microphone
phoneSteps.wifi: Connect your phone to the same Wi-Fi as this computer.
phoneSteps.scan: Scan this code with your phone's camera and open the link in the Chrome browser.
phoneSteps.advanced: If the Chrome browser shows a warning page, tap Advanced, then Proceed to connect.
phoneSteps.record: On your phone, tap the orange button and speak.

startHidden.label: Avvia in Background
startHidden.description: Avvia l'applicazione in background senza aprire la finestra.

pauseMediaWhileRecording.label: Pause Music While Recording
pauseMediaWhileRecording.description: Pause music or video that is playing while you dictate, and play it again afterwards.

autostart.label: Avvia all'Accensione
autostart.description: Avvia Chatelle automaticamente quando accedi al computer.

style.title: Overlay
style.label: Style
style.description: Scegli l'overlay di registrazione: 'Nessuno' lo nasconde, 'Minimo' mostra una barra compatta, 'In tempo reale' mostra la trascrizione in tempo reale mentre parli (solo per modelli che supportano lo streaming — cerca il badge 'Streaming' nel selettore del modello). Su Linux si raccomanda l'opzione 'Nessuno'.

position.title: Posizione della Sovrimpressione
position.label: Position
position.description: Mostra un feedback visivo in sovrimpressione durante la registrazione e la trascrizione. Su Linux si raccomanda 'Nessuna'.

chooseBeforeTyping.label: Choose Before Typing
chooseBeforeTyping.description: AI Reply and Guide the AI Reply give you three replies to pick from. When off, Chatelle types the first reply straight away.

pasteWithClipboard.label: Paste with Clipboard
pasteWithClipboard.description: Paste the text in one go instead of typing it key by key. Faster, but pages that block pasting refuse it.

typingSpeed.title: Typing Speed
typingSpeed.description: How fast Chatelle types your text. Normal suits most apps. Slow looks most like a person typing; Fast finishes long replies sooner.

replyKeys.title: API Keys
replyKeys.description: To write a reply, Chatelle sends the chat to the first service below that has a key. Add at least one free key. Keys are kept in your computer's secure key store.

speechModel.afterStopDetails: {{size}} MB · Types after you stop, with fewer errors

logs.hint: The log records what Chatelle did and the errors it hit, so the developer can find and fix the problem.
logs.share: Something not working? Copy the log and send it to the Chatelle developer.

remoteReply.title: Telegram Alerts
remoteReply.description: When you are away, Chatelle watches the open chat and sends new messages and suggested replies to your Telegram.
remoteReply.disclaimer: Your computer stays awake while alerts are on. Click the chat's message box, then press your Message Alerts shortcut to start.

steps.title: How to connect
steps.wait: Wait a few seconds. Status changes to “Connected to your Telegram”.
steps.phone: Install Telegram on your phone and sign in with your phone number.

remoteReply.newPhone: New phone or number? Click Unlink, then follow the steps again from the new phone.

setup.title: How to set up Telegram alerts
setup.intro: Telegram alerts send new chat messages and suggested replies to your phone while you are away. First make your own Telegram bot. It is free and takes about two minutes.
setup.botFather: In Telegram, tap the search bar at the top of the Chats screen and type BotFather. Open @BotFather (the one with the blue tick) and tap Start. On this computer, you can click the button instead.
setup.names: Type a name for your bot, like My Chatelle. Then type a username. The username must be unique across all of Telegram and must end in “bot”. Add your own name or some numbers to make it unique, like ann_chatelle_2026_bot. If BotFather says the username is taken, try another one.
setup.token: BotFather replies with a token, a long code that looks like this: 91568140:AA2c-RWQV1fW-_TgQYWyz-e3TuurQ. Copy it.
setup.paste: Paste the token here and click Save. The steps to connect your phone then appear.
setup.private: Keep the token private. Anyone who has it can control your bot.

floatingDock.title: Floating Buttons
floatingDock.description: Keep Chatelle's buttons on top of your other apps: AI Reply, Voice Reply, Guide AI and Alerts.

autoFocusInput.title: Click the Message Box for Me
autoFocusInput.description: Chatelle finds the chat's message box and clicks it, so you don't have to before it writes a reply.

quickActions.title: One-Click Buttons
quickActions.draftDesc: Reads the chat, types a reply
quickActions.hintDesc: Tell AI what the reply should say
quickActions.watchDesc: Tells your Telegram about new messages
quickActions.hintStopDesc: Stop talking and write the reply

micPermissionDenied.generic: L'accesso al microfono è stato negato dal sistema operativo. Concedi l'autorizzazione al microfono nelle impostazioni di sistema.
micPermissionDenied.windows: Abilita l'accesso al microfono in Impostazioni → Privacy e sicurezza → Microfono (incluso l'accesso delle app desktop).
micPermissionDenied.macos: Concedi l'accesso al microfono in Impostazioni di Sistema → Privacy e sicurezza → Microfono.
micPermissionDenied.linux: Concedi l'accesso al microfono nelle impostazioni audio o sulla privacy del tuo sistema.
